notes.title: Playtest is Open!
notes.content:
🎮 IT Hell Playtest is Now Open! 🎮

Dear Gamers,

I'm thrilled to announce the open playtest of my upcoming game, IT Hell! As a solo developer, crafting this game has been an incredible journey, and I'm excited to invite you to be a part of its development.

At this stage, there isn't a formal feedback system in place yet. However, your thoughts and experiences with the game are incredibly valuable.

To join the playtest, simply click the "Request Access" button on the IT Hell store page.

Also, adding the game to your wishlist is a great way to show support!

Regrettably, my availability for game development is currently limited. Nevertheless, I'm striving to allocate the time I can to finalize new levels and add more content to the game.

Take care!
-Thug Rabbit Games

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
What's new:

 HR Dept. added to the game - now Player can upgrade their Stats
 Prompt for interaction is added to some of the objects witch which the Player can interact


What's updated/changed:

 Player and Enemy Dev. sprites are updates - now they have muscular hands
 Changed the lighting in some levels and the light source of the flashlight
